title: test(dogfood): the authz census and the matrix docblock read the runtime route ledger as the 92 rows it holds
body:
Fixes #24056

Clause-②: no
Basis for the Clause-② line: a test-only change to a private package (`@objectstack/dogfood`). No request, schema or published text changes.

No changeset: `@objectstack/dogfood` is private and the diff is test-only, so this PR takes `skip-changeset` (the seat writes the label).

## What changed

Two pins in `packages/qa/dogfood` still read `packages/runtime/src/route-ledger.ts` as 88 rows. The ledger has held 92 rows since PR #24009 (for #23909) ledgered the `GET`, `PUT`, `PATCH` and `DELETE /keys` mounts. `main`'s `Dogfood Regression Gate` has been red on shards 1/3 and 3/3 since then. The ledger is right; the pins follow it. `packages/runtime/src/route-ledger.ts` is unchanged.

- `test/authz-probe-blind-spot.census.ts`, the route-ledger row: `population` and `reachable` move 88 -> 92, and `blindSpot` stays 0. The `"route: '"` and `"domain: '"` controls move 88 -> 92, and `RouteLedgerEntry` stays at 2. `keys` stays 23. One dated history comment in the row's own style says which four rows arrived. The population-source docblock line in the same file moves to "92 rows over 23 domains".
- `test/authz-conformance.matrix.ts:28`: the one figure the docblock-figure pin in `authz-conformance.test.ts` reads, `(88 rows / 23` -> `(92 rows / 23`. Nothing else in the file changes.

Every figure was measured on the ledger at base `905f57bc7` with the census's own rule (the scoped `ROUTE_LEDGER` table): 92 `route: '`, 92 `domain: '`, 23 distinct domains and 5 rows carrying `domain: '/keys'` (the existing `POST /keys` row plus the four new ones), so all four new rows are reachable through an existing key. Whole-file controls: 92 / 92 / 2.

## Which figures the checker reads

The docblock-figure pin (`checkFoldedDocblockFigures` in `authz-conformance.test.ts`) reads only `authz-conformance.matrix.ts`. It folds the comment continuations, then reads the backticked ledger path followed by `(N rows / M families|domains)`, one per ledger: `packages/rest/src/rest-route-ledger.ts` (81 rows / 18 families, already correct) and `packages/runtime/src/route-ledger.ts` (was 88 rows / 23 domains). It reads nothing in the census file. The census test reads the row's numeric fields, not its prose.

## Verification

All runs went through `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`. The closure was built with `pnpm exec turbo run build --filter='@objectstack/dogfood^...' --concurrency=2`: VERDICT command-exit 0, 65 of 65 tasks.

Command: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 test/authz-conformance.test.ts test/authz-probe-blind-spot.test.ts`

| tree | result |
|---|---|
| base `905f57bc7` | VERDICT command-exit 1, `Tests 4 failed \| 104 passed (108)`: exactly the four tests named on the card, and nothing else red in either file |
| `86ed87210` (census row only) | VERDICT command-exit 1, `Tests 2 failed \| 106 passed (108)`: only the two docblock-figure tests remain |
| head `3888a39e7` | VERDICT command-exit 0, `Test Files 2 passed (2)`, `Tests 108 passed (108)` |

Ablations, one per changed figure. Each went through `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (WRAP mode: the anchor must hit, the write and the restore are proven on disk):

- Census `population: 92,` -> `population: 88,` (anchor x1 -> x0, blob `9841799b7a20` -> `0816269a58bc`): `authz-probe-blind-spot.test.ts` gave `Tests 1 failed | 46 passed (47)` on "packages/runtime/src/route-ledger.ts — population, reach and blind spot are unchanged", `expected 92 to be 88`. Restored: blob == HEAD `9841799b7a20`, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- Matrix `(92 rows / 23` -> `(88 rows / 23` at head `3888a39e7` (anchor x1 -> x0, blob `c5d3442b8a73` -> `97d165b1593b`): `authz-conformance.test.ts` (61 tests, 2 failed) red on "every figure the docblock states equals what its ledger holds TODAY" and "the anchor is the PATH, ..." (`docblock says 88 rows, the table holds 92`). `authz-probe-blind-spot.test.ts` stayed green (47 / 47). Restored: blob == HEAD `c5d3442b8a73`, `git diff HEAD` empty.

Both ablations went red, the predicted direction. No `dist/` is on the path, because the tests import these modules by relative path.

Other local readings at head `3888a39e7`:

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood exec tsc --noEmit --listFiles` gave VERDICT command-exit 0, with both changed files in the program.
- `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config` over both changed files exited 0, with no output. A control-byte grep over both files found none.
- Gate union: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` (2 paths vs merge base `905f57bc7`) derived 47 commands, all run at `3888a39e7`, each exit captured before any pipe. 46 exited 0. `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exited 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET: 8 packages outside the dogfood closure have no `dist/`, so it is NOT MEASURED locally (CI builds the whole tree). The `--ran` reconciliation exited 0: "47 derived, 46 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN".
- `origin/main` moved 3 commits past the base while this was open (to `b1d5569d9`). None of them touches the two dogfood test files, the census, the matrix or `route-ledger.ts`, and the one runtime file among them has no reader in `packages/qa/dogfood`. No merge.

⚠️ The two pins this PR moves run only in `main`'s push battery: the `dogfood` job in `ci.yml` is skipped for `pull_request` and `merge_group` events. This PR's check-runs therefore cannot show them; the local readings above are the evidence, and the next `main` battery's `Dogfood Regression Gate` (1/3) and (3/3) is the confirmation.

## Acceptance notes

- The census population-source paragraph (`authz-probe-blind-spot.census.ts` around `:103`–`:114`) still says `packages/rest/src/rest-route-ledger.ts`: 82 audited rows over 18 families, while `REST_ROUTE_LEDGER` holds 81 rows / 18 families at `905f57bc7` (the census row itself records 81). Its "290 rows in total" was not re-measured. No checker reads either figure, and both are outside this card's surface, so they are left as they are. carrier: none.
- This card is derived from #23050, and PR #24054 (its slice 11) edits other rows of the same census and `authz-conformance.test.ts`, not `authz-conformance.matrix.ts`.
